metrics.name: final_results

descriptions.lgbm_global: LightGBM on all features (calibrated on validation).
descriptions.sequence: PyTorch CNN over the raw 30-day window (calibrated).
descriptions.single_llm_agent: One LLM agent seeing all attributes with the same tools; risk from the all-features model. Note: numeric risk identical to lgbm_global by construction; differs only in the graph run (planning, explanation)
descriptions.multi_agent_no_rag: Specialist agents + calibrated stacking fusion, no retrieval.
descriptions.full_system: Specialists + case-memory risk + calibrated fusion + cost policy + abstention + drift-aware recalibration.
descriptions.no_media_health: Full system without the media_health agent (fusion refit without it).
descriptions.no_mechanical: Full system without the mechanical agent (fusion refit without it).
descriptions.no_thermal: Full system without the thermal agent (fusion refit without it).
descriptions.no_usage_wear: Full system without the usage_wear agent (fusion refit without it).
descriptions.no_knowledge_retrieval: Full system without knowledge retrieval. Note: knowledge snippets only ground explanations; numeric results equal the full system, differences appear in the graph-run explanation metrics
descriptions.no_calibration: Raw (uncalibrated) agent scores pooled in log-odds space, no recalibration.
descriptions.majority_vote: Naive majority voting of agents instead of calibrated fusion.
descriptions.no_cost_policy: Fixed probability threshold (0.5) instead of the expected-cost policy.
descriptions.no_drift_recalibration: Full system with static calibration (no drift-triggered recalibration).

metrics.notes:
Sets: test, unseen; seeds [0, 1, 2]; evaluation on the natural class distribution (uniform sample capped at 400000 windows per set).
Costs: 1 unit = one planned replacement; a missed failure costs the cost ratio. 'model' escalation outcome = the reviewer applies the policy's suggested action (conservative); 'oracle' = the reviewer picks the hindsight-best action (optimistic).
single_llm_agent uses the all-features model for its risk, so its numeric metrics equal lgbm_global; no_knowledge_retrieval equals full_system numerically.
